PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -ge 5170 -and $_.LocalPort -le 5185 } | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -AutoSize)
PowerShell(foreach \($p in 29940, 32952\) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($proc\) { "PID $p : $\($proc.ProcessName\)  started $\($proc.StartTime\)" } })

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5173,5174,5175,8000 } | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Port=$_.LocalPort; Addr=$_.LocalAddress; PID=$_.OwningProcess; Name=$p.ProcessName } } | Sort-Object Port | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(foreach \($p in 29940, 32952\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "killed PID $p" } catch { "PID $p already gone" } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $left = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5173,5174,5175 }; if \($left\) { "STILL LISTENING:"; $left | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "ports 5173-5175 are now free" })

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5173,5174,8000 } | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Port=$_.LocalPort; PID=$_.OwningProcess; Name=$p.ProcessName } } | Sort-Object Port | Format-Table -AutoSize; if \(-not \(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5173,8000 }\)\) { "nothing listening on 5173/8000" })

PowerShell($ports = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5173,5174,8000 }; if \($ports\) { $ports | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Port=$_.LocalPort; PID=$_.OwningProcess; Name=$p.ProcessName } } | Sort-Object Port | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { "NOTHING listening on 5173 / 5174 / 8000 - both servers are down" })
